feedback.Physical Object: Excluded — A holiday is a scheduled observance, not a physical item.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — A religious holiday is a human-defined institution with invented structure and timing.
feedback.Powered: Excluded — Requires no energy or machinery.
feedback.Structural: Excluded — Not part of any load-bearing structure.
feedback.Observable: Excluded — Its instantiations are visible, but the holiday itself is a symbolic event in time.
feedback.Physical Medium: Excluded — May involve embodied rituals, but not a medium in itself.
feedback.Active: Excluded — Requires human performance; not autonomously operative.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Created by religious or cultural authorities for commemorative and instructional purposes.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Excluded — Induces effects through participation, but not an effect-emitting system.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Excluded — Not an input-processing or logic-modifying system.
feedback.State-Transforming: Excluded — May signify transformation, but does not alter internal system state.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Excluded — Participatory, but not designed for interactivity in the technical sense.
feedback.System-integrated: Excluded — Important to cultural systems but not embedded as operational modules.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Excluded — Requires human recognition and cultural support.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Societies can exist without any particular holiday.
feedback.Symbolic: Included — Encodes values, narratives, or sacred meanings.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Publicly identifies participants with a faith or group identity.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Dates, rituals, and practices are often precisely defined.
feedback.Compositional: Included — Built from traditional modular elements (rituals, processions, meals, rest periods).
feedback.Normative: Included — Instructs moral behavior and reinforces social roles.
feedback.Meta: Excluded — Does not refer to its own structure.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Defined by the calendar, recurrence, or liturgical cycles.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Excluded — Lived and performed, not instantiated virtually.
feedback.Social Construct: Included — Exists entirely through cultural convention and shared belief.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Codified by religious institutions or traditional canons.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Included — Expresses religious and communal identity.
feedback.Regulated: Included — May be protected or enforced through civic or religious law.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Alters markets, labor patterns, travel, and consumer activity.
feedback.Politicised: Included — Often contested in multicultural or secular societies.
feedback.Ritualised: Included — Enacted through fixed ceremonial patterns.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Expresses ideals such as gratitude, sacrifice, humility, or forgiveness.

encoding_notes: This encoding treats the religious holiday as a synthetic, rule-structured, symbolic social system enacted in time. It is defined by institutional and cultural authority, structured ritual, and recurring ethical meaning. Though abstract, it has strong normative, political, and economic dimensions.
